notes: Ordinal weights, not probabilities of scoring. Bot estimates are priors for ordering only; reports use report-decision.v2.

bot_filter.notes: Suspicion is scored on 0-100 (ctn/moderation/detector.py uses >=85 to confirm a bot; the Discord panel says the score is not a probability). 2026-10-20 22:00: the first version of this rule said 0.7 because it was written as if the score were 0-1, so every author with any signal at all was skipped (1457 of 4575 accounts, 32%) and replies fell from 116/h to 72/h. The live distribution is 3116 accounts at 0, 520 at 1-9, 844 at 10-39, 91 at 40-69, 2 at 70+. 40 filters 93 accounts (2%) and leaves the weak signals alone; accounts that simply do not answer us are handled by caps.second_reply_requires_response instead.

caps.second_reply_notes: A second reply to the same author is only sent when that author has replied to one of our posts since our previous reply: an author who ignored us is not a conversation, and a citizen who just moved is harder to move again in the same session (organiser note 2026-10-19).

thread_depth.notes: Organiser note 2026-10-19: NPCs are less likely to reply in deep threads. Depth 0 = top-level post. Targets deeper than max_target_depth are skipped, except a citizen replying directly to us, where we answer at most followups_when_replying_to_us times per thread per day.
